system.description:
When taking a long rest outside of a haven, you can use a trapline to snare wild animals or warn you of danger. Determine your passive tinker’s tool DC when you set your trapline. If a random encounter is rolled during a long rest, the attackers must beat your DC on a perception check or set off the trapline. If you have a loaded firearm, or a grenade, on your trapline, the creature must make a saving throw against your combat maneuver DC or take damage as if hit by an attack. On a natural 1 against a firearm trapline, they take damage as if it were a critical hit.

Whether attached to a firearm or simply something noisy, sleeping creatures within 100ft of you wake when the trapline triggers and cannot be surprised.
